Record Class AdocCoordinates

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.plugin.adoc.AdocCoordinates
Record Components:
groupId - the group, for example network.ike.lab
artifactId - the artifact, for example topics
version - the version the library was declared or found at
public record AdocCoordinates(String groupId, String artifactId, String version) extends Record
The Maven coordinates of a topic library: the artifact that ships a set of packages. The classifier is always adoc and the type always zip, so neither is carried.
